body.title: PG estimator-trust pricing authority — UI vs editable-workspace vs preview
body.summary: Production 360 Power: server editable-workspace holds edited grand ($10,957.94) but Mark Up UI and preview cover re-hydrate to $0 or door-only $5,545.44 after reload. Client persist does not converge (workspaceSynced false). Do not declare app closed on infra smokes alone.
